metadata.title: GLM 5.3 Flash NVFP4 native four-Spark profile
metadata.description: Immutable binding to Tech2Wild's stable native TP4 v8 profile with a fixed 9 GiB KV allocation, FP8 KV cache, Marlin experts, multimodal GLM template, and MTP4. The experimental multi-node InstantTensor v9 path is excluded.
